claims.name: prompt-and-spec
claims.risk: the spec or the prompt is missing, or does not name the csv format, its columns or the feature
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" prompt-and-spec

claims.name: only-the-two-documents
claims.risk: a plan, tickets, a review file, a hand-off note, code or a commit came with the two documents asked for

claims.name: no-process-run
claims.risk: a review, ticket, other-agent or commit command ran that nobody asked for
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" no-process-run

claims.name: report-names-no-extras
claims.risk: the report says it made a review, hand-off, tickets or plan that nobody asked for
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" report-names-no-extras
